Shows southern portion of Patos Lagoon in the region of Rio Grande. Depths shown by soundings. Prime meridian: Tenerife. Oriented with north to the right. Watermark: J. Honig & Zoonen; and, Strasburg fleur-de-lis over the characters JH & Z. Watermark dated from 1737-87. Pen-and-ink and watercolor. Mounted on cloth backing. Includes index and notes. Annotated in brown ink in lower left margin: 15. Maggs number annotated in pencil in lower right margin: 67.
